mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the permissive factor, which determines the growth of capacity in supplying diverse goods to the population. iii."
Advancing technology is the permissive factor, which determines the growth of capacity in supplying diverse goods to the population. iii.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to refer to the total transformation of a system: thus, when used to describe a nation, describes the transformation of the various aspects of the life of the nation."
The concept development is used to refer to the total transformation of a system: thus, when used to describe a nation, describes the transformation of the various aspects of the life of the nation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the devil's workshop goes the adage and much of the political unrest on the African continent can be attributed to the presence of unemployed, frustrated and alienated young people."
An idle mind is the devil's workshop goes the adage and much of the political unrest on the African continent can be attributed to the presence of unemployed, frustrated and alienated young people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the National Planning Office, Joint Planning Board and the National Economic Council."
The major ones are the National Planning Office, Joint Planning Board and the National Economic Council.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to these plans as a special type of planning."
Business experts sometimes refer to these plans as a special type of planning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condition fundamentally different from undevelopment."
Underdevelopment is a condition fundamentally different from undevelopment.
fib: ______ refers to this as preference for personal expediencies as against public principled interests.
Freed Riggs refers to this as preference for personal expediencies as against public principled interests.
______ is a prominent feature as surveys have shown that 40 percent of the countries have had successful or attempted coups.
Political instability is a prominent feature as surveys have shown that 40 percent of the countries have had successful or attempted coups.
______ is the responsibility of the bureaucracy, another organ of the state.
Plan implementation is the responsibility of the bureaucracy, another organ of the state.
______ is referred to as a process whereby the real per capita income increases accompanied by reduction in inequalities of income and the satisfaction of the preferences of the masses as a whole.

Economic development is referred to as a process whereby the real per capita income increases accompanied by reduction in inequalities of income and the satisfaction of the preferences of the masses as a whole.
______ is the foundation of a society or what (Ake 1981) referred to as the base, and if it is strong, it will have positive impact on the political system which is the super-structure.
The economy is the foundation of a society or what (Ake 1981) referred to as the base, and if it is strong, it will have positive impact on the political system which is the super-structure.
______ is a process of improved decision- making rather than the output of those decisions.
The essence of development is a process of improved decision- making rather than the output of those decisions.
